mentions.name: Pitchwise
mentions.description: A cost-effective DocSend alternative for sending pitch decks and data rooms as secure, branded links. It surfaces real investor engagement signals such as slide-level analytics, return visits, and forwards.
mentions.problem: Tools like DocSend for sharing decks and data rooms with investors are expensive; Pitchwise offers a cheaper option.
mentions.audience: Founders and startup teams sending fundraising materials to investors.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building pitchwise.se - a cost effective Docsend alternative for sending decks and Data Rooms as secure branded links and see real investor signals -- slide-level analytics, return visits, forwards, etc.

evidence.value: Building pitchwise.se - a cost effective Docsend alternative for sending decks and Data Rooms as secure branded links and see real investor signals -- slide-level analytics, return visits, forwards, etc.
